access_failures: Individual MDPI articles and PDFs returned HTTP 429; publisher-index metadata and author/institutional copies were used where available.
ACM publisher page returned HTTP 403; primary proceedings contents used for Beyond Detection metadata.
OpenReview forum required a browser challenge; accessible conference-labelled PDF used.
IEEE document 11400389 exposed no useful fields; author publication list used for limited metadata.
Crossref API web requests for six candidate DOIs returned internal errors; terminal fallback DNS failed. Candidate DOI strings from discovery were not promoted without primary confirmation.
ACL direct .bib link unavailable; official HTML BibTeX/metadata and PDF were accessible.
coverage_gaps: No exhaustive literature search or absence-of-prior-art claim.
Original Tables III–VII lack reconstructable logs and remain unverified historical claims.
Most of original references 1–20 were verified at metadata/abstract level; only explicitly listed method sections were inspected.
Unresolved final publication pagination/version details for originals 1,3,4,5,9,10,12–20 are omitted when not confirmed.
WAFBooster preprint and original journal citation have different author lists; final journal metadata remains unverified.
MCPTox repository was not pinned/downloaded as a study corpus; the original 485 definitions claim is not validated.
The corpus labels are supplied source taxonomy, not proof that Sentinel-TPD semantically recognizes each family.
The inspected MCP-Guard and MCPShield methods have broader/different boundaries than the Sentinel-TPD local scanner; their published rates are not comparable head-to-head.
Pinned fuzzd declares MIT in package/README but lacks a license text/corpus-specific license at pin; no external raw payloads are redistributed.
reuse_note: Selected previously verified protocol/binding entries are imported from the immutable prior sentinel-binding-research source dossier with their recorded read scopes, rather than re-researched.
